learning_outcomes.text: Be aware of the multidisciplinary context of engineering.
Practical application of engineering: Understanding of applicable techniques and methods of analysis, project, and research, and their limitations in their field of specialization.
Practical application of engineering: Knowledge of the application of materials, equipment and tools, technology, and engineering processes, and their limitations in their field of specialization.
Practical application of engineering: Ability to apply engineering practice standards in their field of specialization.

Practical application of engineering: General ideas on economic, organizational, and management issues (such as project management, risk, and change management) in the industrial and business context.
Communication and Teamwork: Ability to effectively communicate information, ideas, problems, and solutions in the field of engineering and with society in general.
Applies methods, techniques, regulations, etc., typical of the engineering profession in known contexts.
Makes decisions and evaluates the possible consequences of the selected alternative.
Defines the problem, develops the solution, and presents conclusions effectively, using correct language in writing.
Defines the problem, develops the solution, and presents conclusions effectively, using correct language orally.
Coordinates their work with other team members, contributes to the team in the development of tasks to be performed, and the creation of a good working environment.

syllabus_topics: Execution of tasks assigned by the company
teaching_methods: Realization of internships in real environments

assessment_methods.method: Technical capacity, involvement in the project/PBL, work performed, results obtained, documentation submitted, technical presentation and defense
Observation of student participation and attitude in the proposed training activities

assessment_rules: The course will have continuous assessment based on meetings with tutors. With the feedback offered in these meetings and partial submissions, students must improve the quality of their work, activity, report, and presentation until the final evaluation. If the course is not passed or the final report is not submitted, the course must be repeated.
